verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a coding agent with cloud tasks and saved chats, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not document any retention setting, deletion capability, or zero-data-retention option. Resuming and searching saved chats (codex resume) and organization RBAC are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
